name: eez-studio-mcp-bridge
author: eez-studio-mcp-server
description: Hosts the localhost MCP bridge inside EEZ Studio so the eez-studio-mcp server can inspect, edit, render, run, and build the live LVGL project (207 tools). Drop-in project extension — no app patching. Adds a floating 'MCP Bridge' panel in the bottom-right corner.
